text:
Maya: Drafted release note for the cache + batching perf work and the Dedicated canary UX. Need a quick sweep on: known issues, SDK snippets (py/js), and the Private migration blurb. Aiming to publish tomorrow morning.

Elliot: Drop the draft link?

Maya: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/cache-batching-rollout-2026 (WIP)

Priya: I'll take snippets. Which SDK versions to show? Recommend py v1 examples and a note for v0.9 compat.

Maya: Yes show v1 by default, include a v0.9 callout. Streaming example should demonstrate `stream=true` and `cache.prefetch=true`.

Dan: Known issue we must call out: small tokenization diffs with some 4-bit quant kernels on long contexts. Add a mitigation section (re-tokenize or bump tolerance) and link to eval artifacts.

Zoe: For Private customers add a short migration checklist: config diff (`kv_cache.enabled` -> `cache.kv_enabled`), helm override example, and a warmup curl to prime KV after deploy.

Priya: Draft Python snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="RELETED")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood-fast-1",
  input="Summarize the change",
  stream=True,
  options={"cache": {"prefetch": True}, "batch": {"max_tokens": 512}}
)
for chunk in resp.stream():
  print(chunk.text)
```
I'll add the JS equivalent.

Elliot: Small nit: show the options shape and annotate that v0.9 users need `client.options` namespace. Add a one-liner migration pointer.

Maya: Good. Also include a customer-facing blurb: "measurable per-route latency improvements and cost savings" and keep the exact benchmark internal (we can note internal bench ~22% per-route token cost reduction).

Dan: Can we add an "opt-out" line for operators who want legacy behavior? e.g., `cache.kv_enabled=false` in the deployment spec.

Zoe: I'll write the helm override and the rollback command: `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/inference-worker`. Also update screenshots anchors if needed.

Maya: docs-bot: please schedule a publish dry-run + snippet-lint tomorrow 18:00 UTC and a linkcheck sweep.

docs-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z. Snippet linter and linkcheck queued.

Priya: After linting I'll push snippets and mark ready for review. If linter flags version mismatches I'll leave comments inline.

Elliot: Aim to merge by EOD after green lint. If blockers, ping @Maya.

Maya: Thanks all 1 :thumbsup: — flipping to "ready for review" after Priya's snippet updates and Zoe's migration blurb is in.
